notice: Research leads, not reviewed live globe events. No counts or pins until editorial approval. Coordinates are approximate site or administrative locations, not precise occurrence coordinates.

events.title: Pompeii Archaeological Park publishes report on newly uncovered private baths and banquet hall
events.date_basis: Official excavation journal publication date (17 January 2025); actual excavation dates are not established. UNESCO follow-up published 4 February 2025.
events.location_basis: UNESCO World Heritage component 829ter-001 (Pompeii), site reference point rather than precise excavation or publication location
events.classification_rationale: Provisional positive classification of a documented archaeological report that expands knowledge of Roman domestic architecture; not a measure of global conditions.
events.source_record_id: Pompeii Archaeological Park excavation journal, 17 January 2025, Regio IX insula 10; UNESCO news 2741 (follow-up); property component 829ter-001
events.location_note: UNESCO's component table identifies Pompeii (829ter-001) at N40 45 4, E14 29 10; converted from degrees/minutes/seconds and rounded to six decimal places. The excavation journal identifies Regio IX, insula 10, within Pompeii. The pin would reference the whole archaeological site, not the precise room, excavation point or place of publication.
events.source_limitation: UNESCO summarizes the earlier Italian announcement and is not independent confirmation of the excavation journal. The precise excavation dates, room coordinates and proposed ownership are not independently established by these sources.
events.map_review_requirement: Do not promote into the public feed until editorial approval and map UI explicitly labels site-reference locations and publication dates. Do not count the UNESCO follow-up as a separate discovery, or infer relationships to other ancient sites.

events.title: UNESCO approves $85,000 in conservation-capacity assistance for Koh Ker
events.date_basis: Committee approval date recorded in assistance request 3599; not implementation date
events.location_basis: UNESCO World Heritage property 1667 reference point (beneficiary site, not decision venue)
events.classification_rationale: Provisional positive classification for a documented conservation funding approval, not a measured conservation outcome.
events.source_record_id: UNESCO international assistance 3599; World Heritage Committee decision 48COM 11, paragraph 2(2)
events.location_note: UNESCO lists property 1667 at N13 46 59, E104 32 14; converted to decimal degrees rounded to six places. This is the reference point of the heritage property receiving assistance, not where the Committee met, where training occurred, or an exact activity location.
events.source_limitation: UNESCO records approval of USD 85,000 and a pending implementation step; expert CVs are required before implementation. Neither disbursement nor completed conservation work is established by this record.
events.map_review_requirement: Do not promote into the public feed until editorial approval and map UI explicitly distinguishing a beneficiary-site reference from an occurrence location; no geographic relationship to other cases is established.

events.title: WHO Director-General announces end of COVID-19 public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC)
events.date_basis: 5 May 2023 official WHO determination and announcement; Emergency Committee met by videoconference on 4 May 2023.
events.location_basis: Global policy determination; the 5 May announcement is identified as Geneva, Switzerland, but no exact announcement coordinates are established in the reviewed sources.
events.classification_rationale: Provisional neutral policy milestone; the international emergency designation ended, not COVID-19 as an ongoing health threat.
events.source_record_id: WHO IHR Emergency Committee fifteenth meeting statement, 5 May 2023; WHO Director-General briefing and transcript, 5 May 2023
events.location_note: WHO dates its briefing to 5 May in Geneva; the transcript identifies WHO headquarters at 00:00:48. The committee met virtually on 4 May. These sources do not establish a precise point for the policy determination or any geographic distribution of its effects. Previously staged coordinates had no cited coordinate authority and have been removed.
events.source_limitation: All three citations originate from WHO; they document its own determination and announcement, not independent corroboration of epidemiological outcomes or a location for worldwide effects.
events.map_review_requirement: Keep this lead out of the geographic feed and pins. Preserve it for editorial review and non-geographic topic search only after approval; a future map placement needs traceable coordinates and an explicit announcement-location label, not an inferred disease epicenter.

events.title: DOJ reports additional Epstein Files Transparency Act publication
events.date_basis: DOJ press release 26-84 and congressional letter dated January 30, 2026; press release updated February 1, 2026. This is the disclosure date, not any underlying incident date.
events.location_basis: Washington, D.C. press-release dateline and issuing-office letterhead; no exact geographic occurrence or publication coordinates established.
events.classification_rationale: Provisional neutral classification of a documented disclosure announcement; no judgment about completeness, underlying allegations, or the impact of the release.
events.location_note: Press release 26-84 has a Washington dateline; DOJ letter to Congress, page 1, identifies Washington, D.C. as the issuing office address. The letter (page 2) describes materials collected across multiple offices and jurisdictions and uploaded over the course of the day. Neither document supports the previously staged coordinate or a crime-location pin. Coordinates intentionally withheld.
events.source_record_id: DOJ Office of Public Affairs press release 26-84 (2026-01-30); DOJ letter to Congress, media 1426091, pp. 1–2 (2026-01-30)
events.source_limitation: DOJ reports more than 3 million additional pages and nearly 3.5 million cumulatively, not 3.5 million newly released pages. The letter and announcement are from the same agency and do not independently establish completeness or authenticate all underlying submissions. DOJ cautions that false material may be included. Do not surface victim-identifying information or infer wrongdoing from names in records.
events.duplicate_review_note: Read-only Supabase lookup found the exact press release URL already indexed as unpublished source ID 75. Existing case titles #99, #114 and #142 match broad topic screening; this does not establish a relationship to any of them. Reuse source 75 in editorial review; do not create a duplicate source or canonical case.
events.map_review_requirement: Keep out of geographic feed and pins. After editorial approval, retain for non-geographic source discovery with existing source record 75. Any future pin must have traceable coordinates and explicitly distinguish an issuing-office reference from an incident location. Do not create links to alleged crime locations or individuals from this disclosure alone.
